inputKind: a Vector of one or more entries, each a two-element Vector of a name (a String) and an amount (an exact number); a name may appear in several entries

tasks.prompt: Leave the sum of all amounts.
Leave a Record from each name to the sum of its amounts, names in order of first appearance.
tasks.reference: ZIP 'Z' BIND Z 0 GET Z 1 GET GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD

tasks.prompt: Leave the name whose amounts sum to the most; when several tie, the one that appears first.
tasks.reference: ZIP 'Z' BIND Z 0 GET Z 1 GET GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET

tasks.prompt: Leave a Vector of the names whose amounts sum to less than zero, in order of first appearance (an empty Vector when there are none).
tasks.reference: ZIP 'Z' BIND Z 0 GET Z 1 GET GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS 'K' BIND K NIL G VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP 0 LT SELECT [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER

tasks.prompt: Leave the number of distinct names.
Leave the entry (the two-element Vector of name and amount) with the largest single amount; when several tie, the first of them.
tasks.reference: 'L' BIND L L ZIP 1 GET -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
